Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Primary use: low-latency risk scoring and KYC enrichment in underwriting flow (~300 reqs/s peak).
- Key constraints: PII retention rules, on-prem/offline auditability, 99th pct latency target ~120ms.
- Success metric: cut manual reviewer time by 30% and reduce false positives.

Next steps
1) Share a short scope for a 2-week scoped POC (what success looks like + sample data needs).
2) Intro to procurement/legal for contract & security review (if you want, I can loop in our legal).
3) Technical sync with Rishi to line up environment and data access.

I attached the deck from today (Redwood_FinReg_Deck_v2.pdf) and a one-pager with our POC template. Could you share who from your side should be on the procurement & legal threads and a couple possible windows next week for a short scoping call?

If priority has shifted, totally understand — just let me know timing and I’ll adjust.
